sql: SELECT 'open_pos_by_hour' AS what, to_char(date_trunc('hour', created_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS k, count(*)::text AS v FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Emmsell10' AND closed_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'post_rearm_opens', COALESCE(market_ticker,'-'), to_char(created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Emmsell10' AND created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 23:51:41+00' UNION ALL SELECT 'live_order_since_rearm', market_ticker||' '||COALESCE(status,'?'), to_char(created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Emmsell10' AND created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 23:51:41+00' ORDER BY 1,2
